label: Shebaniah

A.name: Shebaniah
A.line: stood on the Levites platform (NEH 9:4) and exhorted Israel to bless the Lord (NEH 9:5)
A.notes: named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:12)
family: descendant-of levi (Levi, third-born son of Jacob (GEN 29:34), son of Leah)

B.name: Shebaniah
B.line: Second Levite of this name in the same covenant-sealing list, distinct from the first

why: שְׁבַנְיָה follows Zaccur and Sherebiah at the second Shebaniah entry in the Levite covenant-sealing list, matching B's stated position. A's platform role does not establish this identification, and its verse note repeats the disputed attribution.
